tools.name: move_contacts_between_lists
tools.description: Moves subscribers from one mailing list to another by updating their list membership, and returns the contacts that were moved. Reads the source list to find the contacts and removes them from it as part of the move.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite database of the email platform

params.name: source_list_id
params.description: ID of the list to move contacts out of

params.name: target_list_id
params.description: ID of the list to move contacts into

params.name: emails
params.description: Email addresses of the contacts to move

tools.name: update_campaign_subject
tools.description: Changes the subject line of a draft campaign and returns the previous and new subject. Fails to change anything if the campaign is no longer a draft.

params.name: campaign_id
params.description: ID of the campaign to edit

tools.name: tag_inactive_subscribers
tools.description: Finds subscribers who have not opened any email in the given number of days and adds an inactive tag to them. Returns how many subscribers were tagged and a sample of their addresses.

params.name: days
params.description: Days without an open before a subscriber counts as inactive

params.name: list_id
params.description: ID of the mailing list to check

tools.name: send_campaign_webhook_notice
tools.description: Posts a notice to the team's Slack webhook announcing that a campaign has been sent, including its name and recipient count.

params.name: recipient_count
params.description: Number of recipients the campaign went to
